title: Build Apple Shortcuts, email and share-sheet ingress runtime
summary: Build the full Apple/macOS/iOS ingress layer: Share Sheet shortcuts, email ingestion, folder watchers, normalised JSON payloads, queue routing, receipts, telemetry and recovery.

targets: Supabase ops.work_queue when bridge confirms write path

build_outputs_required.name: Payload normaliser
build_outputs_required.details: Accepts file, URL, text, image, audio, email body and attachments; adds hash, source, timestamps, tags, worker_type, lifecycle_state, evidence_type and receipt_required.

build_outputs_required.name: Email ingress
build_outputs_required.details: Dedicated inbox/rules pattern: intake@, research@, receipts@, ideas@ or Gmail labels. Parse message, attachments and sender context into canonical JSON.

build_outputs_required.name: Folder watcher pack
build_outputs_required.details: Folder Actions trigger Shortcut/shell wrapper, produce queue payload, archive originals after receipt.

build_outputs_required.name: Receipt writer
build_outputs_required.details: Every ingress event writes a receipt with idempotency_key, payload_hash, accepted_at, route_result, worker_destination and evidence_state.

build_outputs_required.name: Telemetry hooks
build_outputs_required.details: Track accepted, rejected, duplicate, failed, retried and completed events; dashboard-ready counters.

build_outputs_required.name: Recovery behaviour
build_outputs_required.details: If Bridge/Supabase unavailable, write to GitHub PEN inbox; if GitHub unavailable, local outbox retries; never silently drops.

shortcuts_must_not: own retries beyond local outbox handoff

definition_of_done: At least one Shortcut accepts Share Sheet file/url/text and creates a real PEN inbox receipt.
Email rule path tested with a sample message and attachment.
Folder watcher path tested with one sample PDF/image/text file.
Duplicate idempotency key is rejected or safely no-oped.
Bridge/Supabase route attempted where credentials/runtime are present; GitHub PEN fallback works.
Receipts written and linked back to source event.
Evidence classified REAL only after live run receipts exist.
handoff_instruction: Bridge worker should build repo/package assets, create Shortcut import docs or .shortcut placeholders where possible, implement normaliser/serverless endpoint if Bridge/Supabase credentials are present, and return receipts/runtime evidence. No HITL unless destructive permissions or missing credentials block production writes.
